title: American Mac and Cheese Casserole
description: A classic American comfort food, this easy macaroni and cheese casserole is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente; drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Whisk in flour to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and American cheese until melted and smooth.
Combine cooked macaroni and cheese sauce; transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
